title: Welte-Mignon Advertisements Collection
description:
A TEI edition of print advertisements for the Welte-Mignon reproducing piano that appeared between 1905 and 1930: transcriptions with the layout of their originals, descriptions of all known printings, persons linked to the GND, and an annotation of recurring motifs (topics). The edition is published at https://anz.welte225.org.

The TEI files are in tei/, with the shared encoding description in tei/shared/encoding.xml and the project schema and its ODD in tei/schema/. The source code of the website is in frontend/.
notes: The advertisements published outside Germany, the United Kingdom and the United States, and a few from Germany, were transcribed, encoded and annotated by a large language model (Claude, by Anthropic). Until the editor has checked such an advertisement against its scan, its revisionDesc has status="unchecked". The TEI data are published under CC BY 4.0; the source code of the website under the MIT License.
